resources.string: 𝐉.𝐀.𝐑.𝐕.𝐈.𝐒 uses this service to read the current screen layout and perform taps, swipes, scrolling and typing on your behalf when you ask it to automate a task. No screen content leaves your device except when sent to the AI provider you configured. Disable this service at any time to stop all automation.
Lets 𝐉.𝐀.𝐑.𝐕.𝐈.𝐒 lock the screen and monitor login attempts when you ask it to, and when the Sentry anti-theft protocol is armed.
Keeps the 𝐉.𝐀.𝐑.𝐕.𝐈.𝐒 agent alive while it works in the background.
Running background tasks and device protocols.
Sharing your position with the assistant while a location task runs.
Capturing the screen for the task you requested.
